info.title: Gerrit Code Review REST API
info.description: The Gerrit Code Review REST API. Paths, parameters, and payload schemas are generated statically from the server's REST bindings; human-authored summaries and descriptions are supplied here and merged in at build time.

get.description: Queries accounts visible to the caller. The query is given by the query parameter; use limit and start to page and o to request extra fields.
Returns the details of one account as an AccountInfo entity.

delete.description: Deletes the given account if config enableDelete under accounts section is enabled.

get.description: Checks if an account is active.

put.description: Sets the account state to active.

delete.description: Sets the account state to inactive.

get.description: Gets a list of the user's signed contributor agreements.

example.name: Individual
example.description: If you are going to be contributing code on your own, this is the one you want. You can sign this one online.

get.description: Retrieves the avatar image of the user.
Retrieves the URL where the user can change the avatar image.
Returns the global capabilities that are enabled for the specified user.
Checks if a user has a certain global capability.
Retrieves the details of an account as an AccountDetailInfo entity.

put.description: The new display name must be provided in the request body inside a DisplayNameInput entity.

post.description: Deletes some or all of a user's draft comments. The set of comments to delete is specified as a DeleteDraftCommentsInput entity. An empty input entity deletes all comments.

get.description: Returns the email addresses that are configured for the specified user.
Retrieves an email address of a user.

put.description: Registers a new email address for the user. A verification email is sent with a link that needs to be visited to confirm the email address, unless DEVELOPMENT_BECOME_ANY_ACCOUNT is used as authentication type. For the development mode email addresses are directly added without confirmation.

delete.description: Deletes an email address of an account.

put.description: Sets an email address as the avatar email address for an account. The avatar email address is used for avatar lookup, e.g. via Gravatar.
Sets an email address as preferred email address for an account.

get.description: Retrieves the external ids of a user account.

post.description: Delete a list of external ids for a user account. The target external ids must be provided as a list in the request body.

get.description: Returns the GPG keys of an account.

post.description: Add or delete one or more GPG keys for a user.

get.description: Retrieves a GPG key of a user.

delete.description: Deletes a GPG key of a user.

get.description: Lists all groups that contain the specified user as a member.

post.description: Adds or updates the account in the secondary index.

get.description: Retrieves the full name of an account.

put.description: Sets the full name of an account.

delete.description: Deletes the name of an account.

get.description: Returns a previously obtained OAuth access token.

put.description: Sets/Generates an authentication token with id legacy for an account.

delete.description: Deletes the token with id legacy of an account.

get.description: Retrieves the user's preferences.
Retrieves the diff preferences of a user.

put.description: Sets the diff preferences of a user.

get.description: Retrieves the edit preferences of a user.

put.description: Sets the edit preferences of a user.

get.description: Returns the SSH keys of an account.

post.description: Adds an SSH key for a user.

get.description: Retrieves an SSH key of a user.

delete.description: Deletes an SSH key of a user.

get.description: Gets the changes that were starred with the default star by the identified user account.

put.description: Star a change with the default label. Changes starred with the default label are returned for the search query is:starred or has:star and automatically notify the user whenever updates are made to the change.

delete.description: Remove the default star label from a change. This stops notifications.

get.description: Retrieves the superset of all information related to an account. This information is useful to inspect issues with the account and its permissions. The account state is returned as an AccountStateInfo entity.
Retrieves the status of an account.

put.description: Sets the status of an account.

get.description: Lists the token ids of an account as a list of AuthTokenInfos. The plain text token will never be returned.

put.description: Creates a new token for an account. The token is usually generated. Administrators can also set a specific token for an account.

delete.description: Deletes the token with the given token-id of an account.

get.description: Retrieves the username of an account.

put.description: The new username must be provided in the request body inside a UsernameInput entity.

get.description: Retrieves all projects a user is watching.

post.summary: Add/Update a List of Watched Project Entities
post.description: Add new projects to watch or update existing watched projects. Projects that are already watched by a user will be updated with the provided configuration. All other projects in the request will be watched using the provided configuration. The posted body can contain ProjectWatchInfo entities. Omitted boolean values will be set to false.
Projects posted to this endpoint will no longer be watched. The posted body can contain a list of ProjectWatchInfo entities.

registered_on.description: The timestamp of when the account was registered.

_account_id.description: The numeric ID of the account.

name.description: The full name of the user. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS for change queries + and option DETAILS for account queries.

display_name.description: The display name of the user. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS for change queries + and option DETAILS for account queries.

email.description: The email address the user prefers to be contacted through. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS for change queries + and options DETAILS and ALL_EMAILS for account queries.

secondary_emails.description: A list of the secondary email addresses of the user. + Only set for account queries when the ALL_EMAILS option or the suggest parameter is set. + Secondary emails are only included if the calling user has the Modify Account, and hence is allowed to see secondary emails of other users.

username.description: The username of the user. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS for change queries + and option DETAILS for account queries.

avatars.description: List of AvatarInfo + entities that provide information about avatar images of the account.

_more_accounts.description: Whether the query would deliver more results if not limited. + Only set on the last account that is returned.

deleted.description: Whether the account is deleted. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS

tags.description: List of additional tags that this account has. The only + current tag an account can have is SERVICE_USER. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS

email_address.description: The email address for the external id.

trusted.description: Whether the external id is trusted.

can_delete.description: Whether the external id can be deleted by the calling user.

_account_id.description: The numeric ID of the account.

name.description: The full name of the user. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS for change queries + and option DETAILS for account queries.

display_name.description: The display name of the user. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS for change queries + and option DETAILS for account queries.

email.description: The email address the user prefers to be contacted through. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS for change queries + and options DETAILS and ALL_EMAILS for account queries.

secondary_emails.description: A list of the secondary email addresses of the user. + Only set for account queries when the ALL_EMAILS option or the suggest parameter is set. + Secondary emails are only included if the calling user has the Modify Account, and hence is allowed to see secondary emails of other users.

username.description: The username of the user. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS for change queries + and option DETAILS for account queries.

avatars.description: List of AvatarInfo + entities that provide information about avatar images of the account.

_more_accounts.description: Whether the query would deliver more results if not limited. + Only set on the last account that is returned.

deleted.description: Whether the account is deleted. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS

tags.description: List of additional tags that this account has. The only + current tag an account can have is SERVICE_USER. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS

username.description: The user name. If provided, must match the user name from the URL.

name.description: The full name of the user.

display_name.description: The display name of the user.

email.description: The email address of the user.

ssh_key.description: The public SSH key of the user.

http_password.description: The HTTP password of the user. (deprecated)

tokens.description: A list of tokens in the form of AuthTokenInputs to assign to the user.

groups.description: A list of group IDs that identify the groups to which the user should be added.

account.description: The account details as AccountDetailInfo entity.

capabilities.description: The global capabilities of the account as a CapabilityInfo entity. Not set if the permission backend doesn't use default capabilities.

groups.description: The groups that contain the account as a member as a list of GroupInfo entries.

external_ids.description: The external IDs of the account as a list of AccountExternalIdInfo entities.

metadata.description: Optional account metadata as a list of MetadataInfo entities. If and which metadata is provided depends on the Gerrit setup.

method.description: HTTP method to use with the action. Most actions use POST, PUT or DELETE to cause state changes.

label.description: Short title to display to a user describing the action. In the Gerrit web interface the label is used as the text on the button presented in the UI.

title.description: Longer text to display describing the action. In a web UI this should be the title attribute of the element, displaying when the user hovers the mouse.

enabled.description: If true the action is permitted at this time and the caller is likely allowed to execute it. This may change if state is updated at the server or permissions are modified. Not present if false.

enabled_options.description: Optional list of enabled options. + See the list of supported options below.

name.description: The unique name of the contributor agreement.

description.description: The description of the contributor agreement.

url.description: The URL of the contributor agreement.

auto_verify_group.description: The group to which a user that signs the contributor agreement online is added automatically as a GroupInfo entity. If not set, users cannot sign the contributor agreement online.

tag.description: Value of the tag field from ReviewInput set while posting the review. Votes/comments that contain tag with 'autogenerated:' prefix can be filtered out in the web UI. NOTE: To apply different tags on different votes/comments multiple invocations of the REST call are required.

value.description: The vote that the user has given for the label. If present and zero, the user is permitted to vote on the label. If absent, the user is not permitted to vote on that label.

date.description: The time and date describing when the approval was made.

post_submit.description: If true, this vote was made after the change was submitted.

permitted_voting_range.description: The VotingRangeInfo the user is authorized to vote on that label. If present, the user is permitted to vote on the label regarding the range values. If absent, the user is not permitted to vote on that label.

_account_id.description: The numeric ID of the account.

name.description: The full name of the user. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS for change queries + and option DETAILS for account queries.

display_name.description: The display name of the user. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS for change queries + and option DETAILS for account queries.

email.description: The email address the user prefers to be contacted through. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS for change queries + and options DETAILS and ALL_EMAILS for account queries.

secondary_emails.description: A list of the secondary email addresses of the user. + Only set for account queries when the ALL_EMAILS option or the suggest parameter is set. + Secondary emails are only included if the calling user has the Modify Account, and hence is allowed to see secondary emails of other users.

username.description: The username of the user. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS for change queries + and option DETAILS for account queries.

avatars.description: List of AvatarInfo + entities that provide information about avatar images of the account.

_more_accounts.description: Whether the query would deliver more results if not limited. + Only set on the last account that is returned.

deleted.description: Whether the account is deleted. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS

tags.description: List of additional tags that this account has. The only + current tag an account can have is SERVICE_USER. + Only set if detailed account information is requested. + See option DETAILED_ACCOUNTS

last_update.description: The timestamp of the last update.

reason.description: The reason for adding or removing the user. If the update was caused by another user, that account is represented by account ID in reason as <GERRIT_ACCOUNT_18419> and the corresponding AccountInfo can be found in reason_account field.

reason_account.description: AccountInfo of the user who caused the update.

token.description: The token in plain text. Will only be returned once when creating the token.

expiration.description: The timestamp at which the token will expire or has been expired. If null, token lifetime is unlimited.

id.description: Must be the same as the id used in the URL.

token.description: The new token. Only Gerrit administrators may set the token directly.

lifetime.description: Lifetime of the token. After the given duration the token will be invalid.

url.description: The URL to the avatar image.

height.description: The height of the avatar image in pixels.

id.description: The ID of the change. The format is "'<project>\~<_number>'". 'project' and '_number' are URL encoded. The callers must not rely on the format.

triplet_id.description: The ID of the change in the format "'<project>\~<branch>~<Change-Id>'", where 'project' and 'branch' are URL encoded. For 'branch' the refs/heads/ prefix is omitted.

branch.description: The name of the target branch. + The refs/heads/ prefix is omitted.

full_branch.description: The full name of the target branch. + Always starts with refs/.

topic.description: The topic to which this change belongs.

attention_set.description: The map that maps account IDs to AttentionSetInfo of that account. Those are all accounts that are currently in the attention set.

removed_from_attention_set.description: The map that maps account IDs to AttentionSetInfo of that account. Those are all accounts that were in the attention set but were removed. The AttentionSetInfo is the latest and most recent removal of the account from the attention set.

custom_keyed_values.description: A map that maps custom keys to custom values that are tied to a specific change, both in the form of strings. Only set if custom keyed values are requested.

hashtags.description: List of hashtags that are set on the change.

subject.description: The subject of the change (header line of the commit message).

status.description: The status of the change (NEW, MERGED, ABANDONED).

created.description: The timestamp of when the change was created.

updated.description: The timestamp of when the change was last updated.

submitted.description: The timestamp of when the change was submitted.

submitter.description: The user who submitted the change, as an AccountInfo entity.

starred.description: Whether the calling user has starred this change. Only set if requested.

stars.description: List of star labels that are applied by the calling user to this change.

reviewed.description: Whether the change was reviewed by the calling user. Only set if reviewed is requested.

submit_type.description: The submit type of the change. + Not set for merged changes.

mergeable.description: Whether the change is mergeable. + Only set for open changes if change.mergeabilityComputationBehavior is API_REF_UPDATED_AND_CHANGE_REINDEX.

submittable.description: Whether the change has been approved by the project submit rules. + Only set if requested.

total_comment_count.description: Total number of inline comments across all patch sets.

unresolved_comment_count.description: Number of unresolved inline comment threads across all patch sets.

is_private.description: When present, change is marked as private.

work_in_progress.description: When present, change is marked as Work In Progress.

has_review_started.description: When present, change has been marked Ready at some point in time.

revert_of.description: The change number of the change that this change reverts.

submission_id.description: ID of the submission of this change. Only set if the status is MERGED. This ID is equal to the change number of the change that triggered the submission. If the change that triggered the submission also has a topic, it will be "<id>-<topic>" of the change that triggered the submission.

cherry_pick_of_change.description: The change number of the change that this change was cherry-picked from. Only set if the cherry-pick has been done through the Gerrit REST API (and not if a cherry-picked commit was pushed).

cherry_pick_of_patch_set.description: The patchset number of the change that this change was cherry-picked from. Only set if the cherry-pick has been done through the Gerrit REST API (and not if a cherry-picked commit was pushed).

meta_rev_id.description: The SHA-1 of the NoteDb meta ref.

contains_git_conflicts.description: Whether the change contains conflicts. + If true, some of the file contents of the change contain git conflict markers to indicate the conflicts. + Only set if this change info is returned in response to a request that creates a new change or patch set and conflicts are allowed.

_number.description: The change number. (The underscore is just a relict of a prior attempt to deprecate the change number.)

virtual_id_number.description: The virtual id number is globally unique. For local changes, it is equal to the _number attribute. For imported changes, the original _number is processed through a function designed to prevent conflicts with local change numbers.

owner.description: The owner of the change as an AccountInfo entity.

actions.description: Actions the caller might be able to perform on this revision. The information is a map of view name to ActionInfo entities.

labels.description: The labels of the change as a map that maps the label names to LabelInfo entries. + Only set if labels or detailed labels are requested.

permitted_labels.description: A map of the permitted labels that maps a label name to the list of values that the current user can vote on. + Only set if detailed labels are requested.

removable_labels.description: A map of the removable labels that maps a label name to the map of values and reviewers ( AccountInfo entities) that are allowed to be removed from the change. + Only set if labels or detailed labels are requested.

removable_reviewers.description: The reviewers that can be removed by the calling user as a list of AccountInfo entities. + Only set if labels or detailed labels are requested.

reviewers.description: The reviewers as a map that maps a reviewer state to a list of AccountInfo entities. Possible reviewer states are REVIEWER, CC. + REVIEWER: Users with at least one non-zero vote on the change. + CC: Users that were added to the change, but have not voted.

pending_reviewers.description: Updates to reviewers that have been made while the change was in the WIP state. Only present on WIP changes and only if there are pending reviewer updates to report. These are reviewers who have not yet been notified about being added to or removed from the change.

reviewer_updates.description: Updates to reviewers set for the change as ReviewerUpdateInfo entities. Only set if reviewer updates are requested.

messages.description: Messages associated with the change as a list of ChangeMessageInfo entities. + Only set if messages are requested.

current_revision_number.description: The number of the current patch set of this change. +

current_revision.description: The commit ID of the current patch set of this change. + Only set if the current revision is requested or if all revisions are requested.

revisions.description: All patch sets of this change as a map that maps the commit ID of the patch set to a RevisionInfo entity. + Only set if the current revision is requested (in which case it will only contain a key for the current revision) or if all revisions are requested.

_more_changes.description: Whether the query would deliver more results if not limited. + Only set on the last change that is returned.

problems.description: A list of ProblemInfo entities describing potential problems with this change. Only set if CHECK is set.

plugins.description: Plugin-provided information about the change, as a list of PluginDefinedInfo entities. Only present if a plugin contributes data.

tracking_ids.description: A list of TrackingIdInfo entities describing references to external tracking systems. Only set if tracking ids are requested.

requirements.description: List of the requirements to be met before this change can be submitted. This field is deprecated in favour of submit_requirements. Only set if SUBMIT_REQUIREMENTS is requested.

submit_records.description: List of the SubmitRecordInfo containing the submit records for the change at the latest patchset. This field is deprecated in favour of submit_requirements. Only set if SUBMIT_REQUIREMENTS is requested.

submit_requirements.description: List of the SubmitRequirementResultInfo containing the evaluated submit requirements for the change. Only set if SUBMIT_REQUIREMENTS is requested.

tag.description: Value of the tag field from ReviewInput set while posting the review. Votes/comments that contain tag with 'autogenerated:' prefix can be filtered out in the web UI. NOTE: To apply different tags on different votes/comments multiple invocations of the REST call are required.

author.description: Author of the message as an AccountInfo entity. + Unset if written by the Gerrit system.

real_author.description: Real author of the message as an AccountInfo entity. + Only set if the message was posted on behalf of another user.

date.description: The timestamp this message was posted.

message.description: The text left by the user or Gerrit system. Accounts are served as account IDs inlined in the text as <GERRIT_ACCOUNT_18419>. All accounts, used in message, can be found in accounts_in_message field.

_revision_number.description: Which patchset (if any) generated this message.

author.description: The author of the message as an AccountInfo entity. + Unset for draft comments, assumed to be the calling user.

tag.description: Value of the tag field from ReviewInput set while posting the review. NOTE: To apply different tags on different votes/comments multiple invocations of the REST call are required.

change_message_id.description: Available with the list change comments endpoint. Contains the id of the change message that this comment is linked to.

unresolved.description: Whether or not the comment must be addressed by the user. The state of resolution of a comment thread is stored in the last comment in that thread chronologically.

context_lines.description: A list of ContextLine containing the lines of the source file where the comment was written. Available only if the "enable-context" parameter (see List Change Comments) is set.

source_content_type.description: Mime type of the file where the comment is written. Available only if the "enable-context" parameter (see List Change Comments) is set.

patch_set.description: The patch set number for the comment; only set in contexts where + comments may be returned for multiple patch sets.

id.description: The URL encoded UUID of the comment.

path.description: The file path for which the inline comment was done. + Not set if returned in a map where the key is the file path.

side.description: The side on which the comment was added. + Allowed values are REVISION and PARENT. + If not set, the default is REVISION.

parent.description: The 1-based parent number. Used only for merge commits when side == PARENT. When not set the comment is for the auto-merge tree.

line.description: The number of the line for which the comment was done. + If range is set, this equals the end line of the range. + If neither line nor range is set, it's a file comment.

range.description: The range of the comment as a CommentRange entity.

in_reply_to.description: The URL encoded UUID of the comment to which this comment is a reply.

updated.description: The timestamp of when this comment was written.

commit_id.description: Hex commit SHA-1 (40 characters string) of the commit of the patchset to which this comment applies.

fix_suggestions.description: Suggested fixes for this comment as a list of FixSuggestionInfo entities.

is_ai.description: Whether the comment was created by an AI agent. Not set if false.

commit.description: The commit ID. Not set if included in a RevisionInfo entity that is contained in a map which has the commit ID as key.

parents.description: The parent commits of this commit as a list of CommitInfo entities. In each parent only the commit and subject fields are populated.

author.description: The author of the commit as a GitPersonInfo entity.

committer.description: The committer of the commit as a GitPersonInfo entity.

subject.description: The subject of the commit (header line of the commit message).

web_links.description: Links to the patch set in external sites as a list of WebLinkInfo entities.

resolve_conflicts_web_links.description: Links to the commit in external sites for resolving conflicts as a list of WebLinkInfo entities.

base.description: The SHA1 of the commit that was used as the base commit for the Git merge that created the revision. + A base is not set if: + - the merged commits do not have a common ancestor (in this case no_base_reason is NO_COMMON_ANCESTOR).

ours.description: The SHA1 of the commit that was used as "ours" for the Git merge that created the revision. + - For merge commits that are created by the Create Change REST endpoint "ours" is the SHA1 of the change's target branch (the branch that is specified as branch in the ChangeInput).

theirs.description: The SHA1 of the commit that was used as "theirs" for the Git merge that created the revision.

merge_strategy.description: The merge strategy was used for the Git merge that created the revision. + Possible values: resolve, recursive, simple-two-way-in-core, ours and theirs.

no_base_reason.description: Reason why base is not set. + Only set if base is not set. + Possible values are: + - NO_COMMON_ANCESTOR: The merged commits do not have a common ancestor. + - COMPUTED_BASE: The merged commits have multiple merge bases (happens for criss-cross-merges) and the base was computed.

contains_conflicts.description: Whether any of the files in the revision has a conflict due to merging "ours" and "theirs". + If "true" at least one of the files in the revision has a conflict and contains Git conflict markers. The conflicts occurred while performing a merge between "ours" and "theirs".

line_number.description: The line number of the source line.

context_line.description: The text of the context line.

query.description: A change query limiting results to changes matching this query; has:draft is implied and not necessary to list explicitly. If not set, matches all changes with drafts.

change.description: ChangeInfo entity describing the change on which one or more comments was deleted. Populated with no change list options.

deleted.description: List of CommentInfo entities for each comment that was deleted.

context.description: The number of lines of context when viewing a patch.

tab_size.description: Number of spaces that should be used to display one tab.

font_size.description: Default font size in pixels for change to be displayed in the diff view.

line_length.description: Number of characters that should be displayed in one line.

cursor_blink_rate.description: Half-period in milliseconds used for cursor blinking. Setting it to 0 disables cursor blinking.

expand_all_comments.description: Whether all inline comments should be automatically expanded.

intraline_difference.description: Whether intraline differences should be highlighted.

manual_review.description: Whether the 'Reviewed' flag should not be set automatically on a patch when it is viewed.

show_line_endings.description: Whether Windows EOL/Cr-Lf should be displayed as '\r' in a dotted-line box.

show_whitespace_errors.description: Whether whitespace errors should be shown.

syntax_highlighting.description: Whether syntax highlighting should be enabled.

hide_top_menu.description: If true the top menu header and site header are hidden.

auto_hide_diff_table_header.description: If true the diff table header is automatically hidden when scrolling down more than half of a page.

hide_line_numbers.description: If true the line numbers are hidden.

render_entire_file.description: Whether the whole file should be rendered instead of only the changed parts.

hide_empty_pane.description: Whether empty panes should be hidden. The left pane is empty when a file was added; the right pane is empty when a file was deleted.

match_brackets.description: Whether matching brackets should be highlighted.

line_wrapping.description: Whether to enable line wrapping or not.

responsive_mode.description: The responsive-rendering mode of the diff view. Allowed values are NONE, SHRINK_ONLY and FULL_RESPONSIVE.

ignore_whitespace.description: Whether whitespace changes should be ignored and if yes, which whitespace changes should be ignored. + Allowed values are IGNORE_NONE, IGNORE_TRAILING, IGNORE_LEADING_AND_TRAILING, IGNORE_ALL.

retain_header.description: Whether the header that is displayed above the patch (that either shows the commit message, the diff preferences, the patch sets or the files) should be retained on file switch.

skip_deleted.description: Whether deleted files should be skipped on file switch.

skip_unchanged.description: Whether files without changes are skipped when switching between files.

skip_uncommented.description: Whether uncommented files should be skipped on file switch.

display_name.description: The new display name of the account.

tab_size.description: Number of spaces that should be used to display one tab.

line_length.description: Number of characters that should be displayed per line.

indent_unit.description: Number of spaces that should be used for auto-indent.

cursor_blink_rate.description: Half-period in milliseconds used for cursor blinking. Setting it to 0 disables cursor blinking.

hide_top_menu.description: If true the top menu header and site header is hidden.

show_whitespace_errors.description: Whether whitespace errors should be shown.

syntax_highlighting.description: Whether syntax highlighting should be enabled.

hide_line_numbers.description: Whether line numbers should be hidden.

match_brackets.description: Whether matching brackets should be highlighted.

line_wrapping.description: Whether to enable line wrapping or not.

indent_with_tabs.description: Whether to indent with tabs or not.

auto_close_brackets.description: Whether brackets and quotes should be auto-closed during typing.

show_base.description: Whether to show the inline edit base version or not.

preferred.description: Whether this is the preferred email address of the user.

avatar.description: Whether this email address is the one used to display the user's avatar.

pending_confirmation.description: Set true if the user must confirm control of the email address by following a verification link before Gerrit will permit use of this address.

email.description: The email address. If provided, must match the email address from the URL.

preferred.description: Whether the new email address should become the preferred email address of the user (only supported if no_confirmation is set or if the authentication type is DEVELOPMENT_BECOME_ANY_ACCOUNT).

no_confirmation.description: Whether the email address should be added without confirmation. In this case no verification email is sent to the user. + Only Gerrit administrators are allowed to add email addresses without confirmation.

ref.description: The ref of the patch set.

commands.description: The download commands for this patch set as a map that maps the command names to the commands. + Only set if download commands are requested.

status.description: The status of the file ("A"=Added, "D"=Deleted, "R"=Renamed, "C"=Copied, "W"=Rewritten). + Not set if the file was Modified ("M").

old_mode.description: File mode in octal (e.g. 100644) at the old commit. The first three digits indicate the file type and the last three digits contain the file permission bits. For added files, this field will not be present.

new_mode.description: File mode in octal (e.g. 100644) at the new commit. The first three digits indicate the file type and the last three digits contain the file permission bits. For deleted files, this field will not be present.

old_sha.description: SHA-1 of the file content at the old commit. For added files, this field will not be present.

new_sha.description: SHA-1 of the file content at the new commit. For deleted files, this field will not be present.

old_path.description: The old file path. + Only set if the file was renamed or copied.

lines_inserted.description: Number of inserted lines. + Not set for binary files or if no lines were inserted. + An empty last line is not included in the count and hence this number can differ by one from details provided in DiffInfo.

lines_deleted.description: Number of deleted lines. + Not set for binary files or if no lines were deleted. + An empty last line is not included in the count and hence this number can differ by one from details provided in DiffInfo.

size_delta.description: Number of bytes by which the file size increased/decreased.

diffs_too_expensive_to_compute.description: Whether the diff of the file is too expensive to compute; when set the diff content is omitted.

path.description: The path of the file which should be modified. Any file in the repository may be modified. The commit message can be modified via the magic file /COMMIT_MSG though only the part below the generated header of that magic file can be modified.

range.description: A CommentRange indicating which content of the file should be replaced. Lines in the file are assumed to be separated by the line feed character.

replacement.description: The content which should be used instead of the current one.

fix_id.description: The UUID of the suggested fix. It will be generated automatically and hence will be ignored if it's set for input objects.

description.description: A description of the suggested fix.

replacements.description: A list of FixReplacementInfo entities indicating how the content of one or several files should be modified. Within a file, they should refer to non-overlapping regions.

changes_per_page.description: The number of changes to show on each page. Allowed values are 10, 25, 50, 100.

download_scheme.description: The type of download URL the user prefers to use. May be any key from the schemes map in DownloadInfo.

theme.description: Which theme to use. Allowed values are AUTO or DARK or LIGHT.

date_format.description: The format to display the date in. Allowed values are STD, US, ISO, EURO, UK.

time_format.description: The format to display the time in. Allowed values are HHMM_12, HHMM_24.

expand_inline_diffs.description: Whether to expand diffs inline instead of opening as separate page (Gerrit web app UI only).

relative_date_in_change_table.description: Whether to show relative dates in the changes table.

diff_view.description: The type of diff view to show. Allowed values are SIDE_BY_SIDE, UNIFIED_DIFF.

size_bar_in_change_table.description: Whether to show the change sizes as colored bars in the change table.

legacycid_in_change_table.description: Whether to show change number in the change table.

mute_common_path_prefixes.description: Whether to mute common path prefixes in file names in the file table.

signed_off_by.description: Whether to insert Signed-off-by footer in changes created with the inline edit feature.

email_strategy.description: The type of email strategy to use. On ENABLED, the user will receive emails from Gerrit. On CC_ON_OWN_COMMENTS the user will also receive emails for their own comments. On ATTENTION_SET_ONLY, on emails about changes, the user will receive emails only if they are in the attention set of that change.

email_format.description: The format to use for outgoing email. Allowed values are PLAINTEXT and HTML_PLAINTEXT.

default_base_for_merges.description: The base which should be pre-selected in the 'Diff Against' drop-down list when the change screen is opened for a merge commit. Allowed values are AUTO_MERGE and FIRST_PARENT.

publish_comments_on_push.description: Whether to publish draft comments on push by default.

disable_keyboard_shortcuts.description: Whether to disable all keyboard shortcuts.

disable_token_highlighting.description: Whether to disable token highlighting on hover.

work_in_progress_by_default.description: Whether to set work-in-progress on push or on create changes online by default.

my.description: The menu items of the MY top menu as a list of TopMenuItemInfo entities.

change_table.description: The columns to display in the change table (Gerrit web app UI only). The default is empty, which will default columns as determined by the frontend.

allow_browser_notifications.description: Whether to prompt user to enable browser notification in browser.

allow_suggest_code_while_commenting.description: Whether to receive suggested code while writing comments. This feature needs a plugin implementation.

allow_autocompleting_comments.description: Whether to receive autocompletions while writing comments. This feature needs a plugin implementation.

ai_chat_selected_model.description: The name of the AI model selected for the AI chat. This feature needs a plugin implementation.

label_filter.description: A comma-separated list of label names that limits which label columns are shown in the change table. If empty, all labels are shown.

diff_page_sidebar.description: String indicating which sidebar should be open on the diff page. Set to "NONE" if no sidebars should be open. Plugin-supplied sidebars will be prefixed with "plugin-".

email.description: The email address of the author/committer.

date.description: The timestamp of when this identity was constructed.

tz.description: The timezone offset from UTC of when this identity was constructed.

fingerprint.description: The 40-char (plus spaces) hex GPG key fingerprint.

user_ids.description: OpenPGP User IDs,role=external,window=_blank associated with the public key.

status.description: The result of server-side checks on the key; one of BAD, OK, or TRUSTED. BAD keys have serious problems and should not be used. If a key is OK, inspecting only that key found no problems, but the system does not fully trust the key's origin.

problems.description: A list of human-readable problem strings found in the course of checking whether the key is valid and trusted.

add.description: List of ASCII armored public key strings to add.

url.description: URL to information about the group. Typically a URL to a web page that permits users to apply to join the group, or manage their membership.

group_id.description: The numeric ID of the group.

owner.description: The name of the owner group.

owner_id.description: The URL encoded UUID of the owner group.

created_on.description: The timestamp of when the group was created.

_more_groups.description: Whether the query would deliver more results if not limited. + Only set on the last group that is returned by a group query.

members.description: A list of AccountInfo entities describing the direct members. + Only set if members are requested.

includes.description: A list of GroupInfo entities describing the direct subgroups. + Only set if subgroups are requested.

id.description: The URL encoded UUID of the group.

name.description: The name of the group. + For external groups the group name is missing if there is no group backend that can resolve the group UUID. E.g. this can happen when a plugin that provided a group backend was uninstalled.

visible_to_all.description: Whether the group is visible to all registered users.

http_password.description: The new HTTP password. Only Gerrit administrators may set the HTTP password directly. + If empty or not set and generate is false or not set, the HTTP password is deleted.

generate.description: Whether a new HTTP password should be generated

status.description: The status of the label, one of OK, REJECT, NEED, MAY or IMPOSSIBLE.

applied_by.description: The AccountInfo of the user that applied the vote to the label.

approved.description: One user who approved this label on the change (voted the maximum value) as an AccountInfo entity.

rejected.description: One user who rejected this label on the change (voted the minimum value) as an AccountInfo entity.

recommended.description: One user who recommended this label on the change (voted positively, but not the maximum value) as an AccountInfo entity.

disliked.description: One user who disliked this label on the change (voted negatively, but not the minimum value) as an AccountInfo entity.

all.description: List of all approvals for this label as a list of ApprovalInfo entities. Items in this list may not represent actual votes cast by users; if a user votes on any label, a corresponding ApprovalInfo will appear in this list for all labels.

values.description: A map of all values that are allowed for this label. The map maps the values ("-2", "-1", " 0", "+1", "+2") to the value descriptions.

value.description: The voting value of the user who recommended/disliked this label on the change if it is not "+1"/"-1".

default_value.description: The default voting value for the label. This value may be outside the range specified in permitted_labels.

optional.description: Whether the label is optional. Optional means the label may be set, but it's neither necessary for submission nor does it block submission if set.

blocking.description: If true, the label blocks submit operation. If not set, the default is false.

status.description: The status of the submit requirement, for example OK or NOT_READY.

fallback_text.description: A human readable description of the submit requirement.

type.description: The type of the submit requirement.

url.description: The URL of the menu item link.

name.description: The name of the menu item.

target.description: Target attribute of the menu item link.

id.description: The id attribute of the menu item link.

name.description: The metadata name. Not guaranteed to be unique, e.g. multiple metadata entries with the same name may be returned.

web_links.description: A list of web links as WebLinkInfo entities.

name.description: The new full name of the account. + If not set or if set to an empty string, the account name is deleted.

username.description: The owner of the OAuth access token.

resource_host.description: The host of the Gerrit instance.

provider_id.description: The identifier of the OAuth provider in the form plugin-name:provider-name.

expires_at.description: Time of expiration of this token in milliseconds.

type.description: The type of the OAuth access token, always bearer.

branch_name.description: Name of the target branch into which the parent commit is merged.

commit_id.description: The commit SHA-1 of the parent commit, or null if the current commit is root.

is_merged_in_target_branch.description: Set to true if the parent commit is merged into the target branch.

change_id.description: If the parent commit is a patch-set of another gerrit change, this field will hold the change ID of the parent change. Otherwise, will be null.

change_number.description: If the parent commit is a patch-set of another gerrit change, this field will hold the change number of the parent change. Otherwise, will be null.

patch_set_number.description: If the parent commit is a patch-set of another gerrit change, this field will hold the patch-set number of the parent change. Otherwise, will be null.

change_status.description: If the parent commit is a patch-set of another gerrit change, this field will hold the change status of the parent change. Otherwise, will be null.

name.description: The name of the plugin that contributed the information.

message.description: Plaintext message describing the problem with the change.

status.description: The status of fixing the problem (FIXED, FIX_FAILED). Only set if a fix was attempted.

outcome.description: If status is set, an additional plaintext message describing the outcome of the fix.

filter.description: A filter string to be applied to the project.

problem.description: An error message when project is for example hidden or deleted.

certificate.description: Signed certificate payload and GPG signature block.

key.description: Information about the key that signed the push, along with any problems found while checking the signature or the key itself, as a GpgKeyInfo entity.

start_line.description: The start line number of the range. (1-based)

start_character.description: The character position in the start line. (0-based)

end_line.description: The end line number of the range. (1-based)

end_character.description: The character position in the end line. (0-based)

updated_by.description: The account which modified state of the reviewer in question as AccountInfo entity.

real_updated_by.description: The account which actually modified the state of the reviewer in question as AccountInfo entity. This will be different from updated_by in case of impersonation. For example, if Alice impersonates Bob and changes the state of a reviewer, updated_by will be Bob and real_updated_by will be Alice.

reviewer.description: The reviewer added or removed from the change as an AccountInfo entity. For reviewers by email the AccountInfo doesn't contain an account ID but only the email and optionally a name.

state.description: The reviewer state, one of REVIEWER, CC or REMOVED.

kind.description: The change kind. Valid values are REWORK, TRIVIAL_REBASE, TRIVIAL_REBASE_WITH_MESSAGE_UPDATE, MERGE_FIRST_PARENT_UPDATE, NO_CODE_CHANGE, and NO_CHANGE.

_number.description: The patch set number, or edit if the patch set is an edit.

created.description: The timestamp of when the patch set was created.

uploader.description: The uploader of the patch set as an AccountInfo entity.

real_uploader.description: The real uploader of the patch set as an AccountInfo entity. + Only set if the upload was done on behalf of another user.

ref.description: The Git reference for the patch set.

fetch.description: Information about how to fetch this patch set. The fetch information is provided as a map that maps the protocol name ("git", "http", "ssh") to FetchInfo entities. This information is only included if a plugin implementing the download commands interface is installed.

commit.description: The commit of the patch set as CommitInfo entity.

parents_data.description: The parent commits of this patch-set commit as a list of ParentInfo entities. In each parent, we include the target branch name if the parent is a merged commit in the target branch. Otherwise, we include the change and patch-set numbers of the parent change. + Only set if the PARENTS option is set.

branch.description: The name of the target branch that this revision is set to be merged into. + Note that if the change is moved with the Move Change endpoint, this field can be different for different patchsets.

files.description: The files of the patch set as a map that maps the file names to FileInfo entities. Only set if CURRENT_FILES or ALL_FILES option is requested.

actions.description: Actions the caller might be able to perform on this revision. The information is a map of view name to ActionInfo entities.

commit_with_footers.description: If the COMMIT_FOOTERS option is requested and this is the current patch set, contains the full commit message with Gerrit-specific commit footers, as if this revision were submitted using the Cherry Pick submit type.

push_certificate.description: If the PUSH_CERTIFICATES option is requested, contains the push certificate provided by the user when uploading this patch set as a PushCertificateInfo entity. This field is always set if the option is requested; if no push certificate was provided, it is set to an empty object.

description.description: The description of this patchset, as displayed in the patchset selector menu. May be null if no description is set.

conflicts.description: Information about conflicts in this revision as a ConflictsInfo entity.

seq.description: The sequence number of the SSH key.

algorithm.description: The algorithm of the SSH key.

comment.description: The comment of the SSH key.

valid.description: Whether the SSH key is valid.

status.description: The new status of the account. + If not set or if set to an empty string, the account status is deleted.

rule_name.description: The name of the submit rule that created this submit record. The submit rule is specified in the form of "$plugin~$rule" where $plugin is the plugin name and $rule is the name of the class that implemented the submit rule.

status.description: OK, the change can be submitted. + NOT_READY, additional labels are required before submit. + CLOSED, closed changes cannot be submitted. + FORCED, the change was submitted bypassing the submit rule. + RULE_ERROR, rule code failed with an error.

labels.description: A list of labels, each containing the following fields. + * label: the label name. + * status: the label status: {OK, REJECT, MAY, NEED, IMPOSSIBLE}. + * appliedBy: the AccountInfo that applied the vote to the label.

requirements.description: List of the requirements to be met before this change can be submitted.

error_message.description: When status is RULE_ERROR this message provides some text describing the failure of the rule predicate.

expression.description: The submit requirement expression as a string, for example branch:refs/heads/foo and label:verified=+1.

fulfilled.description: True if the submit requirement is fulfilled for the change.

status.description: A string containing the status of evaluating the expression which can be one of the following: + * PASS - expression was evaluated and result is true. + * FAIL - expression was evaluated and result is false. + * ERROR - an error occurred while evaluating the expression.

passing_atoms.description: A list of passing atoms as strings. For the above expression, passing_atoms can contain ["branch:refs/heads/foo"] if the branch predicate is fulfilled for the change.

failing_atoms.description: A list of failing atoms. This is similar to passing_atoms except that it contains the list of predicates that are not fulfilled for the change.

atom_explanations.description: A map of atoms (as strings) to strings explaining the result. This field only contains atoms for which the explanation is available.

error_message.description: If the submit requirement fails during evaluation, this string will contain an error message describing why it failed.

status.description: Status describing the result of evaluating the submit requirement. The status is one of (SATISFIED, UNSATISFIED, OVERRIDDEN, NOT_APPLICABLE, ERROR, FORCED, TIMEOUT).

is_legacy.description: If true, this submit requirement result was created from a legacy SubmitRecord. Otherwise, it was created by evaluating a submit requirement.

applicability_expression_result.description: A SubmitRequirementExpressionInfo containing the result of evaluating the applicability expression. Not set if the submit requirement did not define an applicability expression. Note that fields expression, passing_atoms and failing_atoms are always omitted for the applicability_expression_result.

submittability_expression_result.description: A SubmitRequirementExpressionInfo containing the result of evaluating the submittability expression. + If the submit requirement does not apply, the status field of the result will be set to NOT_EVALUATED.

override_expression_result.description: A SubmitRequirementExpressionInfo containing the result of evaluating the override expression. + Not set if the submit requirement did not define an override expression. If the submit requirement does not apply, the status field of the result will be set to NOT_EVALUATED.

system.description: The name of the external tracking system.

username.description: The new username of the account.

tooltip.description: Tooltip to show when hovering over the link. Using "Open in $NAME_OF_EXTERNAL_TOOL" is a good option here.

image_url.description: URL to the icon of the link.

basicAuth.description: HTTP basic auth with a username and a generated HTTP password.

tags.name: accounts
tags.description: Accounts, preferences, SSH keys, and capabilities.

tags.name: changes
tags.description: Changes, revisions, comments, reviewers, and edits.
